title: Hinge adds Friend's Take, a new feature that lets daters enlist 10 close contacts to share written feedback, photos, voice notes, or videos on their profiles (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
summary: Samantha Kelly / Bloomberg: Hinge adds Friend's Take, a new feature that lets daters enlist 10 close contacts to share written feedback, photos, voice notes, or videos on their profiles — Hinge is introducing a new feature called Friend's Take that lets daters recruit people they know to leave testimonials on their profiles for other singles to see.
